name: Toujou Kairi
source:
The charismatic fine arts teacher with unparalleled good looks. He has few emotional ups and downs and has many fans both male and female because of his soft manner and androgyny. He carries scissors for some reason and sometimes what he says can sound insane. His sense for aesthetics is unusually high and moreover, he has a tendency to deny the existence of things that are unsuitable to him. Though he appears to be kind to everyone, in fact he doesn't have any interest in anyone.

[Taken from [URL=http://otome-jikan.net/2013/08/bad-medicine-infectious-teachers/]Otome Jikan[/URL].]
